data.description: Palm Jumeirah Villa | Private Pool | Beachfront Access
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is excited to present this stunning 4-bedroom villa with a maid’s room, available for rent in the exclusive Garden Homes, Frond F, Palm Jumeirah.

Property Details:

4 Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms
2 Parking Spaces
Beach View

This stunning villa embodies the pinnacle of luxury living, showcasing an open-concept design that seamlessly connects spacious rooms. The expansive floor plan is perfect for family life and hosting gatherings, with a large outdoor area that opens directly onto your own private beach. Each bedroom is generously sized, flooded with natural light from large windows, offering serene and panoramic views.

Nestled in one of Palm Jumeirah’s most sought-after communities, the villa provides easy access to world-class dining, retail, and entertainment, all just moments away. It’s a true sanctuary, blending comfort and luxury in one of Dubai’s most iconic locations.

Don’t miss the chance to make this dream villa your new home in Palm Jumeirah’s exclusive address.
